| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `htm-preact.module.js` | [htm](https://github.com/developit/htm) `preact/standalone.module.js` (obsahuje [Preact](https://preactjs.com) a hooks) | htm 3.1.1 | htm: Apache 2.0, Preact: MIT |
